_about: Z18: layouts verified in the 2016 zone (PDB export) and the 2016 client handlers. See docs/pseudocode/zone/Z18-leftovers.md.

0x2442.name: NC_BAT_SOMEONESKILLBASH_OBJ_CAST_CMD
0x2442.notes: broadcast to the caster's sight when a servant explosion (meb_Explosion, blastMode 2/4) fires a skill on an object; client: caster.ActSkill(target, 1, skill) unless the caster is the own character or the target is unknown

0x2443.name: NC_BAT_SOMEONESKILLBASH_FLD_CAST_CMD
0x2443.notes: broadcast to the caster's sight when a servant explosion (blastMode 1/3) fires a skill on a spot; client: SetSkillTargetGroundPoint + ActSkill(x, y, 1, skill) unless the caster is the own character
